tuck-box.prompt: A calm, premium product photograph of a luxury playing-card deck on a cream linen tablecloth in soft morning window light. A closed deep oxblood red (#6E1E22) card tuck box with fine gold foil acanthus filigree, a thin double gold border and a small gold laurel wreath medallion in the centre, with NO text or letters anywhere on the box. Beside it, a neat face-down stack of matching cards with the same oxblood and gold symmetrical back, and three cream cards fanned face up showing only fine single-colour line-art engravings (a mountain peak in brick red, an open book in navy, a bowl of greens in forest green) with no text. Matte, quiet, warm, light. No hands, no chips, no dice, no casino, no text, no logos.

binder.prompt: A calm, premium overhead photograph of an open collector's card binder lying on a cream linen tablecloth in soft daylight. Warm brown leather cover, cream pages with clear sleeves in a neat 3 by 3 grid on each page. Most sleeves hold cream playing cards, each with one fine single-colour line-art engraving (mountains in brick red, books in navy, leaves and bowls in forest green, moons over water in plum, linked rings in deep teal) and a thin rule border; a few sleeves are still empty. One card has a gold foil edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no hands. Matte, quiet, light, refined.
